About CITIZEN · For UTOPIZE Project

A little city.
A little zen.
A place for everyone.

CITIZEN is a shared canvas for imagining better neighbourhoods. Bring a place, sketch an idea, and give the conversation somewhere to grow.

01 · The idea

City-making, with breathing room.

Draw on a map or site plan, place symbols, pin notes and save the views that matter. Your workshop stays in this browser; export a session to keep a backup or share it.

Our mark brings a city skyline into an open circle: urban life, a moment of calm, and space for the next idea.

02 · This edition

Made available for UTOPIZE Project.
